headline: Illegal Trade in Argentina Projected to Cost $3 Billion in Tax Revenue
summary: Smuggling and illicit trade in Argentina are projected to cost the state $3 billion in tax revenue this year, representing a 24% increase from 2025 despite falling consumption.
why: Widespread illicit trade undermines state tax collection, distorts domestic retail competition, and impacts Argentine fiscal deficit targets.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Lost tax revenues weigh on government fiscal balance and public accounts.
